definitions.supports: At PASS onset: teammate excluding goalkeeper and sender, 3–30 m away; no rival within 2 m of the interior 8–95% of the segment. Geometric indicator, not a guaranteed pass.
definitions.offBall: No From/To entry for that player in any selected event. Unrecorded touches cannot be excluded.
definitions.accompanying: Forward displacement at least 2 m among players without a recorded touch; descriptive threshold, not tactical success.
definitions.block: Mean signed longitudinal displacement of matched outfield players at both endpoints.
definitions.timing: Original timestamps retained, including event boundaries; variable display intervals, no invented interpolation.
definitions.orientation: First-half Home right/Away left, inferred from goalkeeper positions.

additionalSources.selection: Two fixed 10-second windows from annotated THROW IN and CORNER KICK; descriptive, not representative or used to fit the engine.
